source_standard: Teresa Torres interview snapshots (producttalk.org) + Guest/Bunce/Johnson 2006 and Hennink/Kaiser/Weber 2020 saturation run-length (extension beyond Torres's own confirmed/not-confirmed vocabulary, stated explicitly)

judgment_methodology.method: The Mom Test's three failure-mode filter (compliments, fluff, hypotheticals) to judge whether an interview finding is real signal

planning_methodology.method: Opportunity Solution Tree scoping from outcome to opportunities to solutions before recruiting

deliverable_form.method: Thematic-analysis coded finding with saturation statement
deliverable_form.source: Braun & Clarke, "Using thematic analysis in psychology," Qualitative Research in Psychology, 2006; Guest, Bunce & Johnson, "How Many Interviews Are Enough?," Field Methods, 2006

feedback_methodology.method: Contextual-inquiry review of interview notes for observation vs. opinion conflation

review_methodology.method: JTBD framing check: does the stated need map to a job-to-be-done, not a feature request restated as a finding
review_methodology.source: Christensen and Moesta, JTBD theory; christenseninstitute.org

degree_level_knowledge.source: Braun & Clarke, Qualitative Research in Psychology, 2006; Guest, Bunce & Johnson, Field Methods, 2006

reference_resolution.rule: snapshot_refs must resolve to a real interview_snapshot elsewhere in the record, and every opportunity must be backed by >=1 snapshot_refs entry — Torres's minimum-evidence-count rule (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: saturation must be computed from saturation_run_length (a run of consecutive interviews adding zero new opportunity tags), never asserted as a standalone claim independent of the cited interview_snapshot sequence.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that every `opportunity_tag` entry cites at least one `snapshot_refs` entry, matching the spec's own `reference_resolution` rule
quality_bar.verified_source: Torres, Continuous Discovery Habits (Product Talk LLC, 2021); producttalk.org/opportunity-solution-trees (primary source; Torres's own opportunity-solution-tree method requires each opportunity to trace to observed interview evidence, not an unbacked assertion).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does `quote` capture an observed past behavior or concrete fact, rather than a compliment, a hypothetical ("I would..."), or vague fluff — The Mom Test's own three failure modes?
quality_bar.verified_source: Fitzpatrick, The Mom Test (2013); momtestbook.com (primary source; compliments/fluff/hypotheticals are the book's own named failure modes for a bad interview finding, matching the spec's cited `judgment_methodology`).

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that `saturation_run_length` names a run of consecutive interviews (>=2, per the extension's stated minimum) that added zero new opportunity tags, before `verdict` is set to `pain-confirmed` or `not-confirmed`
quality_bar.verified_source: Guest, Bunce & Johnson, 'How Many Interviews Are Enough?', Field Methods (2006); Hennink, Kaiser & Weber, 'How Many Interviews Are Enough?', Qualitative Health Research (2020) — cited as an extension beyond Torres's own confirmed/not-confirmed vocabulary, per the spec's own `source_standard` note; both studies report code saturation typically reached within a run of the same few consecutive interviews adding no new codes, the run-length basis this criterion operationalizes.

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does the stated need map to a job-to-be-done (the underlying progress the person is trying to make), rather than a feature request restated as a finding — the spec's own `review_methodology`?
quality_bar.verified_source: Christensen and Moesta, JTBD theory; christenseninstitute.org (primary source; the theory's own core claim is that customers hire products for a job, and a feature request is a solution disguised as a need, the exact conflation this checklist item guards against).

quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

use_when.board_condition: a product-discovery hypothesis requires user-interview validation AND no user-discovery record with a pain-confirmed|not-confirmed verdict exists yet for that hypothesis
